mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month, or Rank IC is negative over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in housing starts and retail sales indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through elevated corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST and RSAFS both above their 3-month moving averages fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or interaction term coefficient is negative.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high industrial production growth, rising INDPRO signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth is above 1.5% annually, or Rank IC for INDPRO in this regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the CPI inflation rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals heightened inflationary pressures that prompt central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5pp in 1 month, or Rank IC is negative over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Strong monthly job growth consistently indicates a healthy labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with PAYEMS growth above 100k, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in quarterly GDP and housing starts reflects broad economic strength that elevates corporate profit outlooks, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of GDPC1 growth above 2% and HOUST above 1200k fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or interaction term coefficient is negative.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, rising FEDFUNDS signals reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs that depress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of periods during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS rises, or Rank IC for FEDFUNDS in this regime is below 0.03.
